answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the river of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the nectar re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, rewards vest against future work. What survives to the falcon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
